note: feature blocks. valid: the version, blocks and each step's block (the line of its feature line, null outside) that both parsers produce. invalid: text that must not parse, with every error and its line. Checked by the .NET tests (JourneyBlockTests) and by js/journeys (conformance.test.ts): the two parsers must agree.

valid.name: one block
valid.text:
open /
feature navigation-preview
  click #a
  get title
end
get url

valid.name: two blocks with several conditions
valid.text:
feature a !b
click #a
end
feature build-type:assembler,codex env:edge
click #b
end

valid.name: allow lines and comments inside a block
valid.text:
allow a.example
open /
feature x # why
  # note

  click #a
end # done

invalid.name: nested
invalid.text:
feature a
feature b
click #a
end

errors.message: feature blocks do not nest: close the block opened on line 1 with 'end' first

invalid.name: nested then two ends
invalid.text:
feature a
feature b
end
end

errors.message: feature blocks do not nest: close the block opened on line 1 with 'end' first

this feature block is never closed: add 'end' after its last step
'Nav_Preview' is not a condition: use a feature flag (navigation-preview), build-type:<a,b> or env:<a,b>, each optionally with a leading '!'
usage: end, with nothing after it
